service.method: INSERT INTO BAT_UP_IMUSER ( INS_TIME , EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , DEPT_CODE , POS_CODE , EMAIL , HP_NO , STATUS , JOB_DATE ) SELECT TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF') , EMP_ID , EMP_NAME , DEPT_CODE , POS_CODE , EMAIL , HP_NO , STATUS , JOB_DATE FROM EMPLOYEE_HMS

SELECT INS_TIME , EMP_ID AS USER_ID , EMP_NAME AS USER_NAME_LOC , DEPT_CODE AS DEPT , POS_CODE AS POSITION , EMAIL AS EMAIL , HP_NO AS PHONE , STATUS , JOB_DATE , IF_FLAG FROM BAT_UP_IMUSER WHERE IF_FLAG IS NULL
SELECT USER_ID , MENU_PROFILE_CODE , USER_TYPE FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} AND USER_ID = ${USER_ID} AND #DB_OWNER#nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
SELECT USER_ID FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = $S{COMPANY_CODE}
